invariants.rationale: If a value is returned, it is always either null or an AnimatedTiledMapTile.
tileElement is used to access children regardless of the control path, so it cannot be null at method exit.
If an animated tile is created, its id matches that of the original tile.
If result is not null, then it is a valid object (never equals null).
If result is null, animation information was not present in tileElement.
